_comment: OTA-1044 — the golem card's ROLL pool, the sibling of app/data/dogs/dog-names.json. Different register on purpose: a dog is an animal you name, a golem is a thing you MADE and are sealing a name into the Aetherstone of. These read as titles, works, or epitaphs rather than pet names — one or two words, always sayable, always inside the 16-character cap the name field enforces.
